cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.
